title: Psychedelic Space Octopus
description: A vibrant green one-eyed octopus creature with a large blue iris stands in the foreground surrounded by glowing pink and orange flowers on dark ground. Its tentacles hold colorful patterned spheres while shooting stars, comets, and green-purple aurora lights fill the cosmic night sky behind it.
prompt: A large slimy green octopus monster with one giant blue eye and sharp white teeth stands in a field of glowing pink and orange flowers. The creature holds several colorful patterned spheres with its tentacles. Behind it is a dark cosmic sky filled with purple and green aurora borealis, shooting stars, and floating planets, surreal cartoon style, vibrant colors, detailed textures
